channel.description: Latest articles from Place North West (placenorthwest.co.uk)

item.title: Green light for revised £100m Eden Project Morecambe
item.description: The long-awaited attraction, expected to act as a catalyst for the regeneration of the coastal resort, could finally get going this year after Lancaster City Council gave the go-ahead to the “recalibrated” proposal. The post Green light for revised £100m Eden Project Morecambe appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Cheshire East ditches Flag Lane school plan
item.description: Alternative options for the redevelopment of the former Crewe swimming pool will be considered, the council said, confirming that it will instead fund improvements for high needs pupils within its mainstream schools. The post Cheshire East ditches Flag Lane school plan appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Manchester records bumper Q4 but office take-up dips marginally year-on-year
item.description: While slightly above the five-year average, the 1.14m sq ft transacted in 2025 was 80,000 sq ft below the 2024 total despite a strong final three months, which saw 370,000 sq ft worth of deals inked, according to Manchester Office Agents Forum. The post Manchester records bumper Q4 but office take-up dips marginally year-on-year appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Weis Group wins latest court battle after MCC acted ‘unreasonably’ in tower row
item.description: The High Court ruled that the local authority was wrong to refuse the landowner permission to knock down two warehouses on a site earmarked for a pair of 56-storey skyscrapers. The post Weis Group wins latest court battle after MCC acted ‘unreasonably’ in tower row appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Liverpool seeks to add 400 homes
item.description: Releasing small council-owned plots for development will be combined with transferring long-term vacant homes to a registered provider as the city looks to address its housing shortage. The post Liverpool seeks to add 400 homes appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Approval for Davos’ £64m Liverpool tower
item.description: City councillors voted this morning to approve the 28-storey apartment block, the first phase of the £1bn King Edward Triangle masterplan being delivered by Davos Property Developments and the Hugh Frost-led Beetham Davos. The post Approval for Davos’ £64m Liverpool tower appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: VIDEO | Building a Better Oldham
item.description: The town and wider borough has emerged as one of Greater Manchester’s most attractive investment propositions having pump-primed its regeneration pipeline, attendees at an event exploring investment opportunities in Oldham heard. The post VIDEO | Building a Better Oldham appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Developer looks to lock in 412-bed Salford PBSA consent
item.description: Team Quest International claims work on the redevelopment of a site off Seaford Road into a student housing scheme began ahead of the permission expiring last month. The post Developer looks to lock in 412-bed Salford PBSA consent appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Liverpool unveils masterplan for 100 acres in city centre
item.description: Proposing the construction of more than 7,000 homes, the Pumpfields and Limekilns supplementary planning document will guide the residential-led regeneration of a swathe of brownfield land. The post Liverpool unveils masterplan for 100 acres in city centre appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Lancaster vetoes 200 Green Belt homes
item.description: Deciding that the 28-acre site was not Grey Belt, city councillors voted against officer recommendation to refuse Wrenman Strategic Land’s outline application for a neighbourhood off Slyne Road in Bolton-le-Sands. The post Lancaster vetoes 200 Green Belt homes appeared first on Place North West.
